Tattoo archive

Continuous Render

Works on skin

Pain performs its own archival.

Title

CR — 001

Annotated Portrait

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-05-24

Description

A crimson portrait is held inside a field of black crossings and repeated handwriting. The face persists while the surrounding marks destabilize its frame.

The portrait becomes a contested address: a face held in place by the language that attempts to overwrite it.

Title

CR — 002

Classical Fragment

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-05-01

Description

A sculptural head is compressed into red and black. Broad black strokes interrupt the fragment without dissolving its profile.

Rather than restoring the broken image, the skin holds its interruptions as part of the work.

Title

CR — 003

Horned Figure

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-03-10

Description

A horned figure occupies the centre of a crossed black field. Repeated script moves around the figure like a second, unstable outline.

Recognition and projection occupy the same surface, leaving identity suspended between a body and the figure attached to it.

Title

CR — 004

Interrupted Portrait

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-12-05

Description

A crimson portrait is split by a black band and loose handwritten gestures. The mark remains open to more than one reading.

Here, legibility is negotiated through obstruction; the body carries an image that refuses to resolve into a single account.

Title

CR — 005

Folded Form

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-11-11

Description

A folded crimson form opens across the surface. Fine script and black crossings hold its edges without fixing its movement.

The fold is not an escape from the body but a way of making its surface behave as an opening.

Title

CR — 006

Floral Scaffold

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-10-27

Description

Crimson flowers rise through a thin geometry of black lines. Botanical shapes and drawn vectors share a single surface.

The skin becomes a temporary scaffold where organic growth and diagrammatic order remain in unresolved contact.

Title

CR — 007

Figure and Bloom

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-10-24

Description

A flower and a sculptural profile converge in one crimson shape. A heavy black crossing holds the fragment against the body.

Neither portrait nor ornament settles completely; each survives as a residue within the other.

Title

CR — 008

Single Bloom

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-10-13

Description

A single crimson bloom gathers around a dense black centre. Its descending stem carries the image into open skin.

The flower functions as a compact field of pressure, opening through a surface that continues to move.

Title

CR — 009

Interlaced Band

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-10-13

Description

A crimson band folds back through itself across the arm. Interlaced pattern and black strokes turn the surface into a continuous passage.

Repetition follows the curvature of the arm, making the work a passage that can never be seen from one position.

Title

CR — 010

Radiant Figure

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-10-11

Description

A red figure rises through black crossings and a radiant headpiece. The image stays suspended between outline and interruption.

Radiance becomes a boundary device: the figure appears to emerge while its supporting marks keep it suspended.

Title

CR — 011

Doubled Figure

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-05-07

Description

A crimson figure is prolonged into a dark descending shape. The crossing strokes keep the fragment open to another reading.

Doubling occurs as an overlap rather than a copy, allowing one image to carry incompatible directions.

Title

CR — 012

Body and Petal

Year 2025 (documentation)

Medium Body-based work / Tattoo / Ink on skin / Photographic documentation

Dimensions Not recorded

Palette Crimson / Black

Published 2025-05-05

Description

A skeletal form and a flower share a red silhouette. Black strokes cut through the figure while the petal remains its upper boundary.

The body is both support and subject: a living surface carrying an image in which anatomy and bloom share a boundary.
